title: Telephone telepathy experiments

tellings.quote: virtually everyone is about 85% of the population that you can do experiments on that have done lots and I'm pretty sure it's real

plain: A biologist named Rupert Sheldrake tells podcast host Jesse Michels about experiments he says he ran on telephone telepathy, the idea that people can sometimes sense who is calling before they answer. He says lots of these experiments have been done, that about 85 percent of people can take part in them, and that he is pretty sure the effect is real. If he is right, minds would be linked in ways science does not yet explain.
